target_applications: ISS intravehicular maintenance, dexterous tool use research, GM manufacturing tech transfer

base_type.value: modular: ISS pedestal/stanchion; Centaur 2 4-wheel rover (Earth); 7-DoF climbing leg kit (2014)

max_speed_ms.source: n/a (mounted torso; Centaur base slow rover)

battery_kwh.source: ISS 120V power; battery backpack developed for legged ops

actuators.value: brushless DC + harmonic drives (arms/neck/waist); tendon-driven series-elastic fingers

end_effector.value: two 12-DoF five-finger dexterous hands (2-DoF wrists), designed for unmodified astronaut tools

sensors_head.value: stereo cameras + IR in helmet head

sensors_wrist_hand.value: ~350 sensors total: tendon tension force sensing, joint torque, tactile load cells, finger position

sensors_base.value: depends on mount (Centaur rover sensors separate)

software_stack.value: supervised autonomy + VR teleoperation; ROS r2_description and simulator open-sourced by NASA

safety_compliance.value: NASA human-rating for ISS interior ops (impact-limited, crew-supervised); no terrestrial certifications

availability.value: n/a; retired, NASM museum display since 2024

deployment_evidence.value: ISS 2011-2018 (task boards, switches; largely disabled 2015-18 by power fault); Centaur 2 desert trials 2010; returned to Earth May 2018, never re-flew

notes: First humanoid robot in space. GM partnership yielded RoboGlove (licensed to Bioservo 2016). Lineage: Valkyrie biped (excluded); Nic Radford -> Persona AI.
